headline: Around 50 vehicles robbed on Cox’s Bazar road
summary: Masked gunmen loot cash and valuables from passengers on the Eidgaon-Eidghar-Baishari road, beating some victims before fleeing into the forest.
details: Around 50 vehicles, including CNG-run autorickshaws and motorcycles, were robbed in two separate incidents on the Eidgaon-Eidghar-Baishari road in Cox’s Bazar yesterday.
A group of 10 to 12 masked men armed with weapons blocked the road at Himchhari Dhala in the afternoon, holding passengers hostage at gunpoint.
Victims reported being looted of cash, mobile phones and other valuables. Some passengers were taken into a nearby forest, beaten and robbed of their belongings.
One victim, a manager of a private organisation, lost Tk 1.2 lakh, while another accountant lost Tk 1.5 lakh during the attacks.
Eidgaon Police Station Officer-in-Charge ATM Shifatul Majdar confirmed the incidents, stating that the robbers blocked the road and fled into the forest.
Police teams are currently conducting operations in the surrounding hilly areas to arrest the suspects, though no one has been detained yet.

Local residents say robberies and abductions are frequent on the 17-kilometre hilly road through Ramu and Eidgaon upazilas, with vehicular movement usually stopping after dusk due to security concerns.

headline_marked: 12 killed, 30 injured in [[head-on bus-truck collision]] in Natore
headline: 12 killed, 30 injured in head-on bus-truck collision in Natore
summary: A Barishal-Rajshahi bound bus crashed into a sand-laden truck on the Natore-Pabna Highway, claiming 12 lives.
details: A head-on collision between a bus and a sand-laden truck in Natore’s Baraigram Upazila has left 12 people dead and at least 30 others injured.
The accident occurred at 4:15 am on Tuesday in front of the Bonpara Police Investigation Centre on the Natore-Pabna Highway.
The bus, operated by RP Special Paribahan and traveling from Barishal to Rajshahi, collided with the truck coming from the opposite direction.
Injured passengers were rescued and transported to local private clinics, Natore General Hospital, and Rajshahi Medical College Hospital.
While initial reports suggested 14 deaths, Natore Superintendent of Police Mohammad Shariful Haque clarified that the actual death toll is 12.
The deceased include individuals from Shariatpur, Rajshahi, Patuakhali, and Faridpur, including an 8-year-old girl named Tashfia.
A seven-member investigation committee has been formed to probe the cause of the incident, according to Parliament Whip M Ruhul Quddus Talukder Dulu.
The government has announced compensation of Tk 100,000 for the families of each of the 12 victims.
caption:
12 dead and 30 injured after a bus and sand-laden truck collided head-on in Natore.

A head-on collision between a bus and a sand-laden truck in Natore’s Baraigram Upazila has left 12 people dead and at least 30 others injured.

The accident occurred at 4:15 am on Tuesday in front of the Bonpara Police Investigation Centre on the Natore-Pabna Highway.

The bus, operated by RP Special Paribahan and traveling from Barishal to Rajshahi, collided with the truck coming from the opposite direction.

Injured passengers were rescued and transported to local private clinics, Natore General Hospital, and Rajshahi Medical College Hospital.

While initial reports suggested 14 deaths, Natore Superintendent of Police Mohammad Shariful Haque clarified that the actual death toll is 12.

The deceased include individuals from Shariatpur, Rajshahi, Patuakhali, and Faridpur, including an 8-year-old girl named Tashfia.

A seven-member investigation committee has been formed to probe the cause of the incident, according to Parliament Whip M Ruhul Quddus Talukder Dulu.

The government has announced compensation of Tk 100,000 for the families of each of the 12 victims.
